purpose: High-value ironman permanent unlocks still missing after enrichment packs: Fish Flingers fishing outfit, Thieves' Guild master tools, botanist's amulet, passing bracelet, ore/wood box tier chains, Memorial boons checklist, and Cremation ability (distinct from shades/vyre methods). Wiki-backed effects only — no invented XP/h.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is practical self-sufficient acquisition or use geography. Never use global/multi-region as a region token.
policy.rate_rule: Unlock state and effects only — no invented rates.
policy.duplicate_guard: Do not re-emit: multi-region:slayer-helmet-*, multi-region:toolbelt-*-attach, cross-region:natures-sentinel-outfit, cross-region:master-camouflage-outfit, cross-region:poh-aquarium-prawnbroker, morytania:sticky-fingers-relic, kandarin:shark-outfit-deep-sea, kandarin:fury-shark-outfit, asgarnia:botanists-outfit, asgarnia:factory-outfit.

activity_additions.name: Memorial to Guthix echo boons
requirements: Memorial to Guthix D&D site (Piscatoris / Eagles' Peak area)
Divination energy and memory strands to charge engrams for fountain buffs
unlocks: Permanent Memorial fountain buffs selectable after engram hand-ins
Prestige / concurrent buff slots as wiki progression allows
Account-state Divination passives used as ironman 1–99 backbone
activity_additions.notes: kandarin:memorial-to-guthix is the site hub. This row is the permanent boon checklist planners need — not the geography hub alone. Do not invent energy rates or prestige XP.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Kandarin for the memorial site and fountain selection. Engram farms may pressure other regions only as support.

activity_additions.name: Cremation ability unlock
requirements: Rare drop of the Cremation ability from ghosts / ghost-like monsters (wiki drop tables)
unlocks: Burn bones on player-made fires or portable braziers
2.5× bury Prayer XP and 2× bury Firemaking XP on successful cremation
activity_additions.notes: Distinct from morytania:shades-of-mortton-cremation and morytania:vyre-cremation-sunspear. This is the permanent account ability from ghost drops. Do not invent drop rates. Morytania is primary ghost density pressure; Forinthry revenants and Misthalin ankou are support.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Primary Morytania ghost density. Forinthry/Misthalin are optional farm pressure only.

equipment_additions.name: Fishing outfit (Fish Flingers)
requirements: Fish Flingers D&D access at Isla Anglerine
140 Fish Flingers tokens per piece (560 full four-piece set) from the Fisherman
effects: 1% Fishing XP per worn piece (4% for four pieces)
+1% set bonus when full set worn (5% total)
Does not boost Fish Flingers itself
Fury shark / shark outfits inherit this XP layer after fishing outfit worn at least once
equipment_additions.notes: Base angler-class Fishing XP set. Distinct from kandarin:shark-outfit-deep-sea / kandarin:fury-shark-outfit elite catch/QoL path. Storeable in POH armour case or tackle box.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Kandarin Fish Flingers path. Pair with fury shark for late Fishing stacks.

equipment_additions.name: Master thief's lockpick + master thief's stethoscope
requirements: Thieves' Guild access (Buyers and Cellars series)
Pilfer points for Dodgy Derek purchases (2,500 each for lockpick and stethoscope per wiki shops)
effects: Master thief's lockpick: unbreakable lockpick; toolbelt-eligible; +7% chest lock success (vs 3% ordinary lockpick)
Master thief's stethoscope: permanent safecracking QoL toolbelt path
equipment_additions.notes: Wiki League region for Dodgy Derek / Thieves' Guild is Misthalin (Lumbridge). Required for efficient high-level chests and safecracking/heists. Complements Trahaearn exoskeleton and master camouflage.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin Thieves' Guild. Not Asgarnia.

equipment_additions.name: Botanist's amulet
requirements: Jade amulet + Lvl-2 Enchant (or craft silver + jade + wool then enchant)
Charges consumed when the 4-dose effect triggers (5 charges per new amulet)
effects: Approximately 5% chance to brew a 4-dose potion instead of 3-dose while worn
Stacks with factory outfit 4-dose chance and related Herblore production bonuses
equipment_additions.notes: Ironman Herblore ideal-setup amulet. Craft is global once materials exist; Asgarnia is the practical association via Flash Powder Factory / botanist+factory outfit stack planning. Do not invent mix rates.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Pair with asgarnia:factory-outfit and asgarnia:botanists-outfit. Materials multi-region; Asgarnia is production-stack geography.

equipment_additions.name: Passing bracelet
effects: Unlimited teleports to City of Um: Hanging Gardens, Haunt on the Hill, Reflection Pool
Haunt on the Hill for necrotic rune dark portal; Reflection Pool for ghostly sole fishing
equipment_additions.notes: Ironman Fishing ghostly sole AFK bank loop and RC/necrotic rune QoL. City of Um is Misthalin working taxonomy.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin City of Um destinations. Moonstone materials may pressure Necromancy/Anachronia supply.

equipment_additions.name: Ore box tier upgrades
requirements: Smithing level for each ore box tier (bronze through primal)
Anvil access; upgrade by adding two bars of the next metal to the current box
effects: Stores ores and stone spirits by tier; empties to bank / metal bank / deposit box
Capacity scales with Mining milestones and Everything Is Oresome achievements
equipment_additions.notes: Core ironman Mining logistics chain. Asgarnia Artisans / Mining Guild is the practical smithing loop; Forinthry is support for primal/Daemonheim ore tiers. No invented XP.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Asgarnia primary smith/Mining Guild loop. Forinthry support for late primal tier materials.

equipment_additions.name: Wood box tier upgrades
requirements: Fletching level for each wood box tier (wood through eternal magic)
Prior-tier wood box plus logs of the upgrade tier
effects: Stores logs by tier; empties at bank / deposit box / log pile
Grove upgrades enable wood spirit / nest / geode storage in wood boxes
equipment_additions.notes: Parallel inventory chain to ore boxes. Misthalin Woodcutters' Grove is the fort association for spirit storage; Kandarin is general WC tree pressure. No invented XP.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin Grove association for advanced storage. Kandarin support for tree density.
